title: OpenQuestion
description: An open question tracked in the Feedback & Decisions Log.

id.description: Unique identifier — OQ-01, OQ-P2-01, OQ-P3-01, etc.

phase.description: Phase this OQ primarily belongs to.

question.description: Full question text as recorded in the Feedback & Decisions Log.

owner.description: Person or team responsible for resolving this OQ.

raised.description: ISO date the OQ was raised (YYYY-MM-DD), or null if unknown.

target_resolution.description: Stage, meeting, or milestone by which this OQ should be resolved.

resolution_decision.description: Decision ID that resolved this OQ, or null if still open.

resolution_note.description: Human-readable note on how the OQ was resolved or deferred.

raised_by_decision.description: Decision ID that created this OQ (if applicable).

documents_affected.description: Document codes that need updating when this OQ resolves.

blocking_stage.description: Sign-off stage this OQ blocks, or null if non-blocking.
